title: Minnesota climate-finance funder profiles
grain: one nested profile document per funder/funding-opportunity (not one row per record)
shape: Unlike the tabular compiled datasets, each profile is a structured YAML document in profiles/<funder-slug>.yaml. This file describes the profile object shape, not a flat table. Sibling to dataset-compile/mn-climate-awards/ (the examples layer); the two join on funder + route.
purpose: The machine-readable model of ONE funder that the Concept Note Builder reasons over: it (1) structures the guided interview, (2) drives matching/recommendations toward the funder's gates, and (3) shapes the output concept note to the funder's required template. It defines the '100' in the 70->100 fundability framing.

field_provenance_legend.stated: read from the funder's own program docs / NOFO / RFP (authoritative; must be sourced and status-flagged)
field_provenance_legend.derived: computed from the awards KB (dataset-compile/mn-climate-awards) — the 'revealed' half: who actually wins, typical sizes, applicant types

profile_object.identity: stated — funder, program, administering agency, route (links to the awards KB), instrument, cycle/deadlines, status, geography, statutory basis, typical round size
profile_object.eligibility: stated — applicant types, plan/threshold requirements, activity eligibility, compliance gates
profile_object.match: stated — required match %, eligible forms, restrictions
profile_object.rubric: stated — scoring criteria with point weights; the gates the 70->100 score is measured against
profile_object.required_document: stated — the required application/concept-note sections (the interview spine AND the output template), submission mechanism, char limits, required attachments
profile_object.fit_signals: MIXED — stated focus/hazard/equity + a `revealed_from_awards` block (derived) with typical award size, winning applicant types, category & region split
profile_object.cnb_usage: meta — how each part feeds the interview, matching, 70->100 coaching, and output template
profile_object.provenance: meta — stated source(s), revealed source, last_verified, program-status flag

links.awards: dataset-compile/mn-climate-awards/ — filter funder LIKE '<program>' for the comparable projects; the `route` field is the join key

guardrail: Per PRD: matching criteria are co-calibrated with NLC, not AI-invented. The rubric here is transcribed from the funder's RFP (stated) or flagged as a draft for NLC to confirm — never invented.
promotion_path: compile -> dataset-review (verify stated fields against the live NOFO, confirm rubric with NLC, lock schema) -> the CNB funder-profile service.
